title: Smart Curtain Timer Rules Failing After Power Outage
description: Smart curtain timer rules do not execute after a power outage. Manual and App controls work, but morning auto-open fails. Requires backend diagnosis, physical sync button press, and backend rule resend.

messages.label: User
messages.text: My smart curtains open and close fine when I use the app or pull them manually, but the morning automatic open timer hasn't worked since the power outage yesterday.

messages.label: check_device_logs
refresh_time_zone
Agent
messages.text: The time zone refresh failed because the device isn't in the right mode. To fix this, please press the physical sync button on the smart curtain device itself. Let me know once you've done that.

messages.label: press_sync_button
User
messages.text: Okay, I've pressed the sync button.

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: The timer rules have been successfully resent to your device. The automatic open timer should now work correctly tomorrow morning. Is there anything else I can help you with?

messages.label: User
messages.text: Well, how can we know for sure? I'd rather not wait until tomorrow morning to find out it's still not working.

messages.label: Agent
messages.text:
That's a great point. To confirm the fix without waiting, you can set a new temporary timer in the app.

Please try setting a new one-time "open" timer for about two minutes from now. Let me know if the curtains open automatically at the time you set.

messages.label: User
messages.text: Alright, I've set up a test to have it open in a few minutes.

messages.label: Agent
messages.text: Perfect. Please let me know if the curtains open automatically at the time you set.

messages.label: User
messages.text: It worked! The curtains just opened on their own.
